# Living Flexed Wellness

> Massage & nail art studio based in Round Rock, Texas. Massage and hand-painted nail art by Jessica, one client at a time, in a veteran-owned private studio in Round Rock. Open six days a week.

## Services
- Massage: Swedish, deep tissue, hot stone, sports, trigger point or aromatherapy, tailored to you. Jessica checks in on the pressure throughout.
- Gel-X & acrylic sets: Extensions in any length and shape, from short and simple to long stilettos.
- Custom nail art: Hand-painted designs: florals, chrome, characters, seasonal sets. Come with your vision.
- Manicures: Clean, glossy gel color on your natural nails, done with the same care as a full set.
- Pedicures: Glossy toes in a classic shade or something bold, in a private, quiet room.
- Toe reconstruction: A damaged big toenail rebuilt and finished so it looks like a real, polished nail.

## About
Living Flexed Wellness is Jessica's veteran-owned studio, in Suite 410 at 1000 Gattis School Rd in Round Rock. It is a private space: one client at a time, by appointment. Wellness and beauty go hand in hand here: massage for your body, nails for your hands. Massage clients talk about how she asks what they want before starting, then checks in on the pressure the whole way through, lighter or firmer. Nail clients talk about the detail and how long their sets last, whether it is a simple gel color or a full hand-painted set. Many book again every month. The studio is open six days a week, from 8 AM most days, so there is room before work, at lunch or in the evening.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on the Living Flexed Wellness booking page: pick your service and an open time. You can also text or call (407) 446-0308.
- Q: What massage types do you offer?
  A: Swedish, deep tissue, hot stone, sports, trigger point and aromatherapy massage.
- Q: Do you do Gel-X and acrylic extensions?
  A: Yes. Gel-X and acrylic sets in any length and shape, plus fills, repairs and custom nail art. Toe reconstruction too.
- Q: Can I choose how firm the massage is?
  A: Yes. Jessica asks what you are looking for before you start and checks in during the session, so pressure can go lighter or firmer any time.
- Q: Do you do nails and massage in the same place?
  A: Yes. Massage and nail art are both done by Jessica in the same private studio suite on Gattis School Rd.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday and Wednesday through Saturday 8 AM to 8 PM, Sunday 10:30 AM to 8 PM. Closed Tuesdays.
- Q: Where is the studio, and is it accessible?
  A: Suite 410 at 1000 Gattis School Rd, Round Rock. The entrance has no steps and there is accessible parking near the door. Tap Directions for a map.
